events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Seventy-five years young today! We're celebrating the legendary Chrissie Hynde, a true original and rock 'n' roll force. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks Global James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the first 007 film, Dr. No, which premiered in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day Celebration
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! From 'Dr. No' to the latest blockbusters, 007 has been saving the world in style for over six decades. Which Bond actor is your favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message still resonate.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of comedy. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 years since his passing
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, the world lost a true icon. Remembering the extraordinary talent and stage presence of Freddie Mercury. His legend lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul': 61 years of innovation
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw them push boundaries and redefine pop music. What's your standout track?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 years since his tragic death
events.blurb: On December 8, 1980, the world tragically lost John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, we lost a musical legend. Remembering John Lennon and his incredible impact on music and the world. His message of peace endures.
